changeinfo.changes:
This is a cumulative patch that adds new features and fixes some bugs.
WARNING: All of the PlayStation®3 and PlayStation®Vita systems in a LAN game must have this patch applied in order to join the game.
Features added:
  • Daily Challenge!
  • Extra deathmatch customization

Bugs fixed:
  • Slight slowdown at certain levels
  • Bug preventing players to earn some trophies under certain circumstances
  • Bug detected when two players grab each other at the same time
  • Bug that made the money counter misbehave when losing money
  • Trophies are now displayed correctly in Brazilian Portuguese
  • Many other minor fixes and optimizations

This is a cumulative patch that fixes some bugs.
Bugs fixed:
  • Bug that made the information about the used character and level reached appear incorrectly on the leaderboards under certain circumstances
  • Bug preventing users to post their score when finishing the game in a Daily Challenge
  • Many other minor fixes and optimizations

This is a cumulative patch that adds new features and fixes some bugs.
WARNING: All of the PlayStation®3 and PlayStation®Vita systems in a LAN game must have this patch applied in order to join the game.
Features added:
  • PRO HUD option
  • Daily challenge icon on screen for streamers
  • 'Invert run' option to run by default
  • Sloth damsel (to be unlocked)
  • Revised sounds and textures

Bugs fixed:
  • Now your lowest daily score gets updated only if your current score is higher
  • Many other minor gameplay and sound fixes and optimizations
This is a cumulative patch that fixes a critical bug found in the patch 01.03 that could induce a system lockup under certain circumstances.

This is a cumulative patch that adds new features and fixes some bugs.
WARNING:
  • All of the PlayStation®4, PlayStation®3, PlayStation®TV and PlayStation®Vita systems in a LAN game must have this patch applied in order to join the game.
  • Daily Challenges recorded with an outdated version won't play

Features added:
  • Full support for PlayStation®TV
  • Daily Challenge replays
  • New Fast Forward function for replays
  • Ghosts of dead friends in Daily Challenges

Bugs fixed:
  • Saved games could become corrupted under some circumstances
  • Some textures were being rendered incorrectly when using the quick start feature
  • Desynchronization issues in LAN games
  • Many other minor fixes and optimiztions
